# The New World of Teyvat

**The New World of Teyvat**

A systematic secondary creation and in-depth world-building project based on the worldview of "Genshin Impact".

> 📖 **Online Reading**: [the-new-world-of-teyvat.bstinspection.com](https://the-new-world-of-teyvat.bstinspection.com/) — Built with MkDocs Material theme, auto-deployed on push.

> 📘 **User Manual**: `用户手册.md` — Directory structure, link conventions, formatting standards, editing workflow, and tool reference (local documentation, not published with the site).

> ⚠️ **Disclaimer**: This project is fan-made secondary creation based on the worldview of "Genshin Impact" (HoYoverse). All content is fictional and does not represent any real-world political stance.

## Project Overview

### Design Philosophy

This project attempts to conduct systematic world-building of the Teyvat continent using **comparative politics, development economics, and geopolitical theory** as methodological frameworks. Unlike simple setting catalogs, the project aims to uncover the internal logic of each region—from the structural design of political systems, the endogenous contradictions of economic systems, to the causal chains of historical change, striving to ensure that every fictional setting can withstand the scrutiny of "if this were a real world, how should it function?"

The project starts from historical fragments, character backgrounds, and geographic settings in the Genshin Impact game, then conducts reasonable extrapolation and systematic expansion based on this foundation. For example: How did the war between the Bakufu and Watatsumi Island evolve from religious conflict into a modern political tragedy? How did Liyue transition from a seven-star oligarchic system to people's democracy after the Geo Archon's abdication? How does Fontaine's concept of "justice" materialize under aristocratic republicanism—these inquiries are the starting point of the project's creation.

### Project Scale

- **Nations/Regions**: 7 nations + Nordkarai Autonomous Region under Snezhnaya (Mondstadt, Liyue, Inazuma, Sumeru, Fontaine, Natlan, Snezhnaya);
- **Documentation Count**: 153 content documents; plus 2 repository documentation files (README and User Manual);
- **Document Types**: Political Overview (10), Economic and Industrial Overview (11, including Snezhnaya Economic Overview), Military Overview (8), Administrative Divisions (9), Synthesis/Overview (11), Regional Education Overview (7, plus 1 global education system document), Chronicles (10), Character Profiles (2), Regional Thematic Studies (71), International Documents (14: Global Systems 8 / Multilateral Relations 3 / Bilateral Relations 3);
- **Coverage Dimensions**: Political systems, economic systems, education systems, administrative divisions, military forces, historical evolution, industrial layout, finance and currency, transportation networks, belief systems, multilateral governance, bilateral diplomacy.

## Core Settings

The underlying rules of the Teyvat world are built by eight global system documents (located in `国际/全球体系/`), covering calendar system, transportation, finance, industry, armed forces, information infrastructure, and education systems. The `国际/多边关系/` directory organizes international organizations, treaty systems, and global governance issues; the `国际/双边关系/` directory provides in-depth analysis of political and economic interactions between nations.

LthreeC/pyruns.body:
# pyruns

[English](https://github.com/LthreeC/pyruns/blob/HEAD/README-en.md) | Simplified Chinese

Pyruns is a disk-first run manager oriented toward reproducing experiments and terminal tasks. It stores commands, configurations, logs, environment, run history, and metrics in the project's `_pyruns_` directory and provides a Git-style one-time CLI and optional Web UI.

## Start in 30 Seconds

```bash
pip install pyruns

# Below uses the short entry pyr; pyruns is completely equivalent
pyr --help

# Run and log a command; shell workspace will be created automatically
pyr exec -n smoke -- python -V

# Query results
pyr ls
pyr show smoke
pyr log smoke

# Re-run the same saved task and preserve new numbered run history
pyr run smoke
```

Here, a task is a reusable saved object; each `run` adds a new numbered run without overwriting old logs.

When you don't need to reference a task by name immediately, you can omit the naming parameter entirely; Pyruns will automatically generate `task_YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS`. Use `-nt` when you want to preserve the semantic prefix and automatically append a timestamp:

```bash
pyr exec -- python -V
pyr exec -nt smoke -- python -V       # smoke_YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS
```

`-n smoke` still means the exact name `smoke`, so `-n` and `-nt` are mutually exclusive.

For long tasks, use `--detach`, then control with separate commands:

```bash
pyr exec -n train -d -- python train.py --epochs 100
pyr status
pyr wait train
pyr log train
```

When foreground `exec` / `run` is interrupted by Ctrl+C, it will request cancellation of the task submitted by this command; Ctrl+C for `wait`, `log -f`, or `wait --timeout` only stops observation and the task continues running. Use `pyr stop TASK` when you need to truly stop an existing task.

Start explicitly when you need Web UI:

```bash
pyr ui
pyr ui train.py
pyr ui shell
```

`pyr` and `pyruns` are completely equivalent formal entries; the former is suitable for frequent input, the latter is easier to identify the project name. Use `pyr --help` to see common commands, `pyr help -a` to see the full index, `pyr help COMMAND` to see command details; neither has an interactive REPL that requires continuous manipulation. ...

SoundFieldLab/WaveForge.body:
# WaveForge

Immersive desktop music player (Windows / Electron) supporting **QQ Music + NetEase Cloud Music** dual platforms: search, playback, lyrics, visualization, intelligent recommendations, seamless transitions (DJ-grade crossfade), desktop mode and wallpaper integration. Repository also contains **Android TV** and **Apple Lyrics/Explore** multi-platform branches.

## Quick Start

```bash
npm install                    # Install dependencies
npm run dev:electron           # One-click startup: Vite(3000) + API(3001) + Electron window
```

Development commands must be run from the confirmed WaveForge project root. The team allows the working directory itself to be the project root, or allows a `WaveForge/` subdirectory under a multi-project/AI working directory to be the project root; external automation should first verify `package.json`, `scripts/dev-electron.mjs`, `desktop/main.cjs`, then use `npm --prefix "<project root>" run dev:electron`. Do not write machine-specific absolute paths into scripts or documentation.

- **Advanced Features (Smart AutoMix Beat Matching)**: Project has built-in Python 3.13 runtime (`resources/python-embed/`), ready to use; start `launchers/start-full.bat` or run `python-beat-service/start.bat` first to start the beat service (port **3002**).
- When the beat service is not started, the application automatically downgrades to Fixed Crossfade, without affecting basic playback.

## Core Features

- **Dual-Platform Search and Recommendations**: QQ Music + NetEase Cloud real-time search, daily recommendations, popular songs/rising charts, personalized suggestions
- **QQ Music API Key Acquisition**: Built-in guide window direct to y.qq.com to obtain qmk API Key (isolated session, login state cleared each time on startup)
- **Seamless Transitions**: Three modes — Smart AutoMix (intelligent beat matching + BPM sync, requires Python) / Beat Crossfade (beat cross-fade) / Fixed Crossfade (fixed duration, default)
- **Lyrics System**: LRC parsing, character-by-character lyrics (QQ), real-time scrolling, click-to-seek; character effect modes (crisp/soft/Apple reverse restoration)
- **Spatial Audio**: EngineV3 synthesizes and parses HRTF binaural rendering — one-click spatialization / head-locked surround / world roaming / stage cinema four modes (see "Spatial Audio" section below)
- **Visualization**: Spectrum bars / waveform / circular / 3D visualization

JSLab

Write, run, and manage JavaScript on your wrist

JSLab is a JavaScript development environment for Xiaomi Vela wristbands. lodebar2026/dolce.body:
# Dolce

**Chinese** | [English](https://github.com/lodebar2026/dolce/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

> Open-source jianpu and staff notation editing, score recognition and typesetting tool: compose, recognize, typeset, listen, and export. Available in the browser for immediate use, and also available as Windows / macOS desktop versions; interface is bilingual in Chinese and English.

## Quick Start

| | Entry | Description |
| :-: | --- | --- |
| 🌐 | **[Online Use](https://lodebar2026.github.io/dolce/)** | No installation required, open directly in browser |
| 🍎 | **[macOS Version Download](https://github.com/lodebar2026/dolce/releases/latest)**（`.dmg`, Apple Silicon） | First time opening shows 'corrupted' - see [macOS Won't Open](https://github.com/lodebar2026/dolce/blob/HEAD/docs/macOS-打不开.md) |
| 🪟 | **[Windows Version Download](https://github.com/lodebar2026/dolce/releases/latest)**（`x64-setup.exe`） | Installer, Windows 10/11 x64 |

<sub>Four-part jianpu image (《Holy! Holy! Holy!》) after recognition, open 'side-by-side original': the left is the original image, the right is the score typeset as originally, click a note to simultaneously highlight it on both sides.</sub>

## Features

**Editing**
- Source code on the left, real-time jianpu on the right, reformatting as you type; supports **123** (the main jianpu format for this project, see below), **JP-Word `.jpwabc`**, **text notation** (Tomato jianpu / hymnal 'dynamic notation'), **ABC**, **jianpu-ly `.jly`** (text notation from upstream jianpu-ly that can be passed to it for LilyPond typesetting) five text formats, with syntax highlighting and diagnostic hints.
- **Visual editing**: directly select, insert, and modify notes and symbols on the score (solfege or note names, diatonic degree / semitone / octave, accidentals, note duration, augmentation dots, bar lines, slurs / tie lines, fermata, accent, line breaks and page breaks), with three input methods: keyboard, right-click menu, and symbol panel; jianpu, staff notation, and mixed modes can all be edited; changes are reflected in the source code and share the same undo history with the code area. Key positions align with common music notation software (↑↓ diatonic degree, Alt+↑↓ semitone, Ctrl/⌘+↑↓ octave).
- **Measure operations**: insert, append, delete measures, merge / split measures, change key signature, time signature, tempo, measure line style, measure number and jump marks.

proteus-vue/proteus.body:
# Proteus —— Semantic-Convergent Cross-Platform Application Framework

> **One semantic model. Any render engine. Zero native glue.**
> One semantic kernel, any rendering engine, any native capability. Business code only talks to the semantic layer — rendering foundation, compiler, host container, and execution carrier are all pluggable.
>
> **Not doing cross-platform translation, but building a cross-platform operating system: semantic is the kernel, backend is the driver.**

[Methodological Philosophy](#methodological-philosophy-unified-semantic-convergence) · [Killer Features](#killer-features) · [Quick Start](https://github.com/proteus-vue/proteus/blob/HEAD/docs/getting-started.md) · [Architecture Overview](https://github.com/proteus-vue/proteus/blob/HEAD/docs/board-inventory.md) · [External Positioning](https://github.com/proteus-vue/proteus/blob/HEAD/docs/proteus-positioning-v3.md)

---

## Why is it Called Proteus (Name Origin)

**Proteus** is the sea god in ancient Greek mythology, the shepherd of Poseidon, called the "Old Man of the Sea". In the Odyssey, when captured on the island of Pharos, he transformed into a lion, snake, wild boar, water, and tree. The English word **protean** (metamorphic/shapeshifting) originates from his name; he also knows the past, present, and future.

| Proteus's Divine Attributes | Framework's Differentiated Advantages |
|---|---|
| **Shapeshifting**: One entity transforms into multiple forms | **One Semantic, Multi-Platform Forms**: Same business semantic → Vue DOM / Native / Flutter / Skia / Mini Programs, forms variable, essence unchanging |
| **Prophecy**: Knows the future | **Compile-Time Priority**: Semantic IR converges with validation at build-time, problems that can be discovered at compile-time never reach runtime |
| **Constant Essence**: After transformation, the entity is still Proteus | **Semantic Constancy**: Business code only depends on the semantic kernel, platform differences all sink as backend implementation details |
| **Knows All Things**: Knows past, present, and future | **Verifiable**: Each layer's SPI has conformance gatekeeping, backend implementation compliance is machine-detectable, CI enforces it |
| **Becomes Light**: Transformation reveals all, nothing hides | **Transparent Compilation**: Transformation rules are self-describing (AI manual), decision traces are enumerable and traceable, rejecting black boxes |

## Methodological Philosophy: Unified Semantic Convergence

> **Proteus does not do cross-platform translation, but rather defines a platform-agnostic semantic kernel; all platform differences sink into "backend implementation details".**

Core Formula:

```
Any cross-platform problem = Semantic Definition (framework does) + Backend Implementation (platform does)
```

zdz-666/music_answering_question_system.description: a music AQ system with rag
zdz-666/music_answering_question_system.body:
# Music Assistant (Music Chatbot)

A music knowledge Q&A system based on **RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)**. The backend uses FastAPI + LangChain to orchestrate a complete pipeline of "Query Rewriting → Intelligent Routing → Vector/Web Retrieval → Reranking → Self-Reflection Filtering → Generation", with a React frontend providing a chat interface, and vector data persisted locally by ChromaDB.

---

## Features

- **Multi-Source Retrieval Fusion**: Supports both local knowledge base retrieval and web search simultaneously, with the LLM automatically deciding whether to query the knowledge base, search the web, or both based on the question, without manual switching.
- **Retrieval Reflection**: After retrieval, the LLM determines if the information is sufficient; if not, it performs additional retrieval rounds with reformulated queries, up to 2 supplementary rounds.
- **Query Rewriting**: Converts colloquial user questions into formal queries suitable for vector retrieval; performs separate keyword refinement before web searches.
- **Intelligent Routing (Collection Router)**: The LLM determines which collection(s) a question should query, supporting simultaneous matching across multiple collections.
- **Hybrid Retrieval + Reranking**: Combines Chroma dense retrieval and BM25 sparse retrieval with 0.6/0.4 weighting, then uses a Reranker model to select the top 50% by relevance.
- **Self-Reflection Filtering**: Before generating answers, the LLM filters out irrelevant information from knowledge base/web results.
- **Multi-turn Conversation + Three-Layer Memory**: Conversations are persisted in SQLite (shared across multiple workers, retained on restart), with three-layer memory management—**Working Memory** (last 4 messages + rolling summaries compressed by LLM when exceeding threshold), **Episodic Memory** (cross-session conversation history for the same `user_id`, retrieved by Chroma using semantic similarity), **User Profile** (long-term preferences and entities extracted from conversations, stored in Chroma).
- **File QA**: Upload `.pdf` / `.docx` files with simultaneous parsing of text and embedded images—images are converted to Chinese descriptions by a vision language model (VLM) and participate in QA, scanned pages (without text layer) are automatically recognized through full-page rendering.
- **Dynamic Knowledge Base Writing**: Users can directly input three types of personal data on the frontend—"Personal Information / Music Understanding / Playlists".
- **Offline Evaluation**: Built-in BLEU, ROUGE, and LLM fidelity scoring scripts (`llm_ev.py`), as well as end-to-end evaluation on the RGB Chinese benchmark `zh_refine.json` (300 items) (`rgb_eval.py`, current accuracy 91%).

---
